changes.title: Upcoming invoice endpoints replaced by Create Preview Invoice
changes.description: The Stripe::Invoice.upcoming and Stripe::InvoiceLineItem.list(invoice: 'upcoming') methods were removed in API version 2025-03-31.basil. They are replaced by Stripe::Invoice.create_preview, which returns the same preview invoice object.

detect.notes: Parameters largely carry over: customer, subscription, subscription_items map to the same names on create_preview; subscription_* flat params moved under subscription_details in basil.

replace.guidance: Replace Stripe::Invoice.upcoming(params) with Stripe::Invoice.create_preview(params). Move subscription_items and subscription_proration_date under subscription_details: { items: ..., proration_date: ... }. For listing upcoming line items, create the preview first, then use Stripe::InvoiceLineItem.list(invoice: preview.id).

changes.title: Subscription current_period_start/end moved to subscription items
changes.description: In 2025-03-31.basil, the current_period_start and current_period_end attributes were removed from the Subscription resource. Billing periods are now tracked per subscription item.

detect.notes: Only flag reads from a Subscription object; reads already on items.data[...] are the NEW pattern and must not be rewritten.

replace.guidance: Replace subscription.current_period_end with subscription.items.data[0].current_period_end for single-item subscriptions. For multi-item subscriptions, iterate items to find the relevant item's period.

changes.title: Stripe.api_key global assignment replaced by StripeClient
changes.description: The global Stripe.api_key = 'sk_...' pattern and class-level methods like Stripe::Charge.create are deprecated. Use the instance-based StripeClient pattern: client = Stripe::StripeClient.new('sk_...') then client.charges.create(params).

detect.notes: The StripeClient pattern supports per-request API keys and is thread-safe. Detect both the api_key assignment and direct class-level resource access.

replace.guidance: Replace 'Stripe.api_key = key' + 'Stripe::Charge.create(...)' with 'client = Stripe::StripeClient.new(key)' + 'client.charges.create(params: ...)'. The resource names change from PascalCase class methods to snake_case client attributes: Charge->charges, Customer->customers, PaymentIntent->payment_intents, etc.
